comments.comment: Thank you bro for speaking up on this tragedy ☹️

I was told my daughter was going to have turners syndrome 😕. They kept telling me my body is rejecting the pregnancy and that" i had other options" (meaning abortion) had many complications the entire pregnancy but I stood on the word of God. Even during labor the DR. Snapped the cord while she was still inside of me and she was being strangled and when she came out she wasnt breathing they had to resuscitate her. She is now 9 and my girl is so kind, so generous so intelligent and doesnt have turners . She is completely normal. All GLORY TO GOD!!!
😭 At least we know that sweet angel is in the arms of Jesus.

I have a 23 yr old daughter with special needs whose condition came with a life expectancy of 1 yr. When she was around 2 or 3 someone asked me if I knew she was going to be special while I was pregnant. I let them know I didn’t but even if I did would not have changed anything, she would still be here. My father once said she was born to teach us how to love and that’s exactly what she has done in every circle she’s been a part of. This is sad, they did not know what the Lord had in store
So sad 😞 Lord forgive them ❤️‍🩹
Every baby is a blessing

I never took the genetics tests for my pregnancies. My mother was told I would have downs and was going to abort me but then they told her they took it early and to try again. Tried again and I’m totally healthy and fine. Pregnancy is stressful enough and they say testing helps you prepare just in case. News flash: even with a healthy child you’re not prepared. God gives you grace for each child. So sad. My heart breaks for her that no one could encourage the decision or that they felt there was no better option than that
I believe they probably made that decision because they didn’t want their child to suffer

I once had a friend who did this. I prayed & encouraged her not to terminate her pregnancy because of the diagnosis and she unfriend me. Everyone else around her encouraged it and told her she was making the BEST decision. She asked my opinion & I simply told her I just don't believe in her decision, but she'll always have my support. She even went as far as send me articles on Christian women who had abortions….. (that was crossing boundaries) I just simply can't support that kind of decision bc it goes against Gods will and plans. That baby had a purpose on earth 🌍 and I know it would've beaten the odds...

The mother is obviously suffering from the pain of the decision 😢I pray she finds peace and restoration in Christ Jesus. God is the giver of life only Him should make a decision on the life He has given. Ezekiel 18:4 all souls belongs to God not us.
Sometimes the test are wrong!😑
We need to pray for them but especially her. That cry right there is a cry of suffering and clear regret although she may not say it 🙏
Many times they can't actually from tests. Tests are not 100% accurate. Cldda been a perfectly normal baby

My mom had two broken legs in a car accident hit by drunk driver. She went through 3 months of morphine x-rays in surgeries. She kept on the doctor she was pregnant and they didn't believe her. To shut her up they finally examined her and realized she was pregnant. They priced her for an abortion because the baby was going to have all kinds of issues with all of the surgeries radiation x-rays all this stuff. She stood on God's word my sister's fine. She's perfectly healthy and normal living her life. I was a w-rape baby. My mother was told to have an abortion. She refused. I was able to touch so many lives and I brought two beautiful children into this world.
I went from being pro-choice most of my, to pro life seven years ago, now I’m an abolitionist. This should not be legal, whatsoever.

The doctor could have persuaded them…
I went from pro choice to pro life sometimes it takes decisions, experiences & or time to change our minds.. Christians need to be praying for them not scalding them… I do hope they grow and learn and who knows maybe even adopt a child with Down syndrome. Grace & empathy.. do I agree with their decision no, I don’t, do I think they will regret their decision for the rest of their lives yeah.. I do.

Who is in their shoes? Why are you all casting stones? Which of you has not sinned? We should not have an opinion. Instead pray. This is why many are leaving the Christian faith. The mouths of some of you. No one knowing the darkest secrets you all have hidden in the pits of your hearts. To put people’s lives on display for judgement by imperfect people is a sin. Rest assured Jesus took a thief on the cross to be with him. Many of you may not ever see Jesus, the kingdom or anything pertaining to it. Let God be the only righteous judge. Take the stake out of your own eyes.

I was told my 3rd baby would have down syndrome.. but I kept hearing God say have faith. Don’t believe the lies. And she is healthy vibrant hilarious and absolutely beautiful. Thank you God!!! Abortion is demonic sacrifice. And the death and mental torment that lives inside of your soul after you kill something inside you is something Jesus can only heal. I hope I can help other women see the truth 💕
I remember they told my friend that her son was going to have it . That child is perfectly fine , and he’s 12 now . Can’t always believe those test .

I think what’s heavier is they acknowledged this is their BABY, not a fetus or whatever else argument is out there. They felt the heaviness knowing it was their baby, alive and growing in her but still chose to kill this child💔💔 thank you for ending the video by reminding people to pray for them and their salvation👏🏾 by God’s grace they repent and choose life in Christ
So sad , I feel that’s a very selfish decision.
This discrimination 😭💔, since when a human life with a different intellectual development is less valuable 😭😭😭😭💔💔💔💔

It’s not even an inconvenience. Children with down syndrome are literally a special gift of light and love from God. There could be no more perfect child. These children are not judged in the next life and our promised salvation because they have such perfect beautiful souls. Everyone who has ever had a down syndrome child and kept it says it is the greatest gift in their entire life. And they absolutely regret mourning when they found out because there could be no greater love than what a child with down syndrome can bring into the family and to the Parents life.
No one talks about how ridiculously high medical error is. The THIRD leading cause of death in America. Thousands of babies have had their destiny sealed over false positives.

Yes this was totally wrong! Goes against what God would’ve wanted so now My question is ok so now are we praying for them … restoring or just keep repost this so everyone can speak on it? Let’s pray that they will see their error and repent.
This is insane because they told me this in the hospital about my daughter and she's now 11 and absolutely no sign of down syndrome
